TAM deliverables, QBR/EBR, churn frameworks → tam-operations (references/tam-expertise.md); health-scoring → tam-operations (references/account-health-scorer.md).

AI ethics/governance/model fairness → da-applied-and-communication (references/da-11-ethics-and-privacy.md); adoption/retention measurement → da-applied-and-communication (references/da-21-product-analytics.md, references/da-34-cohort-retention-analytics.md); building/evaluating model or agent → ai-agent-engineering.
